features.title: No more rewinding to find it.
features.subtitle: Everything you need to find a moment in a long video.

jump.title: Go straight to the moment
jump.body: Every result comes with a time. Click it and the video plays from there.

modes.title: Two ways to search
modes.body: Best match puts the most relevant moments first. Exact words finds only the words you type, and lets you combine them.

languages.title: English and Arabic
languages.body: Videos spoken in English or Arabic can both be searched.

guest.title: No account needed
guest.body: Try everything as a guest. If you create an account later, your videos come with you.

how.title: From a long video to the exact moment.
how.subtitle: Three steps, and the last one is the fun part.

upload.title: Upload a video
upload.body: Pick a video from your device. A lecture, a meeting, a podcast, anything with speech.

wait.title: Wait a moment
wait.body: What's said in the video is turned into text, so you can search it.

search.title: Search and jump
search.body: Type a word or phrase. Each result shows when it was said and plays the video from there.

account.a: No. You can continue as a guest and use every feature. If you create an account later, the videos you uploaded as a guest stay with your account.

time.q: How long until I can search a video?
time.a: It depends on the length of the video. Short videos are usually ready in under a minute.

privacy.a: Only you. Nobody else can see, play or search your videos.

words.q: Why didn't my search find a word?
words.a: Search matches whole words, so "searching" won't find "search". Try the exact word that was said. Capital letters and punctuation don't matter.

delete.a: Yes. Deleting a video removes it completely, and it no longer shows up in search.

cta.title: Find the moment you're looking for.
cta.subtitle: Upload a video and search it in minutes. No account needed.

footer.tagline: Search inside your videos and jump straight to the moment.

privacy.title: How your data is used
privacy.intro: What Bahith keeps when you use it, where it's kept, and how to remove it.

account.title: Your account
body: If you continue as a guest, we create an account with no email or name. It's linked to this browser.
If you create an account, we keep your email, your name if you give one, and your password in a scrambled form that can't be turned back into your password.

videos.title: Your videos
body: When you upload a video, it goes straight from your browser to our file storage at Cloudflare. Videos aren't public. They can only be played through links that are made for you and stop working after an hour.
Only you can see, play or search your videos.

transcription.title: Turning speech into text
body: To make a video searchable, we send its sound (not the picture) to Groq, an outside company that turns speech into text. Groq handles it under its own privacy policy.
The text we get back is saved with your video so you can search it.

cookies.title: Staying logged in
body: We save two small login files (cookies) in your browser. They're only used to keep you logged in, for up to 14 days.
Your language and light or dark choice are also saved in your browser. They don't leave your device.

tracking.title: No ads or trackers
body: We don't track you or show ads. Your videos and their text are only used so you can search them.

deletion.title: Deleting your data
body: Deleting a video removes it and its text right away.
Deleting a whole account isn't possible in the app yet. Until it is, you can delete your videos one by one.
If you're a guest and your login ends, for example because you cleared your browser data, you can't get back into that guest account. Create an account if you want to keep your videos.
